card.name: Words before 'drugs' in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS warning text that sit just before a drug-class noun like drugs, antibiotics, medications or solutions. It fires on 'these', 'other', 'class', or on the ending of a long class name.

modes.label: Pointer words before a drug noun
modes.description: 'THESE', 'OTHER' or 'CLASS' right before drugs, medications, solutions or antibiotics.
modes.example: DO NOT MIX OR CO-INFUSE ERTAPENEM FOR INJECTION WITH<< OTHER>> MEDICATIONS.

modes.label: End of a drug-class or route word
modes.description: The last piece of a long all-caps class or route term, with a drug noun expected next.
modes.example: WARNINGS DEMECLOCYCLINE HYDROCHLORIDE, LIKE OTHER TETRACYCL<<INE>>-CLASS ANTIBIOTICS,

card.writes: The promoted tokens are vitamin and cosmetic-style word starts, so it seems to push toward product-category nouns.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a capitalized warning where a drug group is about to be named, such as 'other' before 'medications'.
